# Import Source Analysis Text File

This function requires the **Source Analysis** module.

Use the Source Analysis Text File Import screen to import source analysis data for one or more <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">sources<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>The basis of gas or liquid quality analysis as defined by the user; a source could be a physical sample or online chromatograph; it is a representative sample either manually entered or imported into FLOWCAL and utilized to calculate volumes, mass, components, and gas equivalent values</span></a> in the form of a text file in the format specified by Quorum (contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a> to obtain the file format). The imported source data can then be applied directly to one or more meters.

Refer to the appropriate text file import format document for additional information on the order of fields in the file and whether or not they have any restrictions or are required.

<div class="procedure">

To import a source text file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Source Analysis Text File**.
2.  Click the browse button next to the Import File field to find the import text file (ex. C:\data\01301-July.txt), or type the file path into the field.
3.  Select **Specify Start Time** if the start time is different than what is in the file. If the start time in the file is correct, you do not need to select this option.
4.  The **Specify End Time** option is not required for characteristic records. If the end time is omitted, the characteristic data will be applied until the end time specified in the file. If no end time is specified in the file, it will default to the end of time (1/18/2038) or until the next characteristic is uploaded.
5.  If applicable, select **Source Analysis Number Field is Import ID**. If you are importing data from a third party and the source analysis number in the file is different than the source analysis number in FLOWCAL, you can set up the source analysis number as the import ID in the Quality Source Editor. This will designate the source to import the data into.
6.  Select an edit reason from the **Reason** drop-down or manually enter an edit reason.
7.  Click the **Import** button.
8.  When the import is complete, go to **Setup** \> **Source Analysis** \> **Gas** or **Liquid Quality** to view the analysis data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 468;height: 173;" />

If the source number in the import file is different from the source number in FLOWCAL, you must use the Import ID field to import your data. If the source number does not exist in FLOWCAL, the import fails unless the Auto Create option has been enabled for text file imports under the Service Configuration screen.

</div>

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.
